g.text: R13/R14 sense 0.100 ohm 1 % 1 W 2512 (VSENSE=0: 2.19 A RMS ceiling, 1.5 A RMS recommended). R11/R12 47 R between BRx and SRx. C12/C13 10 nF DNP (long cables / ringing).

g.text: PWR_FLAG on VMOT_RAW, VMOT, VHS, +3V3, GND (VMOT/VHS: no power-output pin drives them; see version-notes.md)

g.desc: PWR_FLAG on VMOT_RAW, VMOT, VHS, +3V3, GND (VMOT/VHS: no power-output pin drives them; see version-notes.md)

g.text: 01 / POWER ENTRY AND PROTECTION: J2 -> F1 -> Q1 (P-FET, source side = VMOT) -> D1 TVS, C1..C3 bulk, R2/D7 VMOT LED

g.desc: 01 / POWER ENTRY AND PROTECTION: J2 -> F1 -> Q1 (P-FET, source side = VMOT) -> D1 TVS, C1..C3 bulk, R2/D7 VMOT LED

g.text: 04 / TEST PADS (bottom side of the PCB, observe only)

g.desc: 04 / TEST PADS (bottom side of the PCB, observe only)

g.text: Block diagram: power entry (J2, F1, Q1, D1, C1..C3) -> VMOT -> U1 (VS, VSA, VSB, VHS, 5VOUT, VCC_IO) -> OA1/OA2/OB1/OB2 -> J3 (A+ A- B+ B-); logic: J1 -> U1 / U2.

g.desc: Block diagram: power entry (J2, F1, Q1, D1, C1..C3) -> VMOT -> U1 (VS, VSA, VSB, VHS, 5VOUT, VCC_IO) -> OA1/OA2/OB1/OB2 -> J3 (A+ A- B+ B-); logic: J1 -> U1 / U2.

g.text: No Gadgeteer 5 V anywhere: U1 makes its own 5VOUT; VMOT must never be called 5 V. Pins 20, 34, 37 of U1 and J1.2 carry no-connect flags; U1 pins 1/33 are tied to VMOT (datasheet 2.2 allows it).

g.desc: No Gadgeteer 5 V anywhere: U1 makes its own 5VOUT; VMOT must never be called 5 V. Pins 20, 34, 37 of U1 and J1.2 carry no-connect flags; U1 pins 1/33 are tied to VMOT (datasheet 2.2 allows it).

g.text: ENN_N is active low; R3 10 k pulls it high (disabled) when the host floats. Firmware must write the registers before enabling (TOFF > 0 and ENN_N low = only state with motor current).

g.desc: ENN_N is active low; R3 10 k pulls it high (disabled) when the host floats. Firmware must write the registers before enabling (TOFF > 0 and ENN_N low = only state with motor current).

g.text: 02b / SUPPLY DECOUPLING (C4..C8), SENSE (R13/R14 0.1 R in the bridge foot, R11/R12 47 R, C12/C13 DNP) AND OUTPUT CLAMPS D3..D6

g.desc: 02b / SUPPLY DECOUPLING (C4..C8), SENSE (R13/R14 0.1 R in the bridge foot, R11/R12 47 R, C12/C13 DNP) AND OUTPUT CLAMPS D3..D6

g.text: 02 / TMC2660 DRIVER U1 AND MOTOR PORT J3 (OA1/OA2 = coil A, OB1/OB2 = coil B)

g.desc: 02 / TMC2660 DRIVER U1 AND MOTOR PORT J3 (OA1/OA2 = coil A, OB1/OB2 = coil B)

g.text: 03 / LOGIC: J1 Gadgeteer Z (host), U2 MISO buffer, pull-ups/downs R3..R10, VIO decoupling C9/C10

g.desc: 03 / LOGIC: J1 Gadgeteer Z (host), U2 MISO buffer, pull-ups/downs R3..R10, VIO decoupling C9/C10

g.text: CERN-OHL-S-2.0 | KiCad only | black solder mask, white silkscreen | v11 study: schematic and placement stage, not routed, not built, not tested.

g.desc: CERN-OHL-S-2.0 | KiCad only | black solder mask, white silkscreen | v11 study: schematic and placement stage, not routed, not built, not tested.

g.text: Population: shipped variant STD, DNP: C12, C13. No hot-plug of VMOT, motor or J1. Q1 gate: R1 100k to GND, D2 12 V Zener limits Vgs. D1 SMBJ26A residual risk: clamp 42 V > 30 V IC maximum.

g.desc: Population: shipped variant STD, DNP: C12, C13. No hot-plug of VMOT, motor or J1. Q1 gate: R1 100k to GND, D2 12 V Zener limits Vgs. D1 SMBJ26A residual risk: clamp 42 V > 30 V IC maximum.

g.text: Gadgeteer Z socket J1: 1 +3V3, 2 +5V (NOT CONNECTED, no load), 3 ENN_N, 4 STEP, 5 DIR, 6 CSN, 7 MOSI, 8 MISO, 9 SCK, 10 GND. Recommended host header: GA (motor SPI).

g.desc: Gadgeteer Z socket J1: 1 +3V3, 2 +5V (NOT CONNECTED, no load), 3 ENN_N, 4 STEP, 5 DIR, 6 CSN, 7 MOSI, 8 MISO, 9 SCK, 10 GND. Recommended host header: GA (motor SPI).

g.text: STATUS: STUDY v11 - UNSUITABLE FOR FABRICATION UNTIL HUMAN REVIEW (high-current: 4 A fuse, ~3 W driver loss, up to 26 V).

g.desc: STATUS: STUDY v11 - UNSUITABLE FOR FABRICATION UNTIL HUMAN REVIEW (high-current: 4 A fuse, ~3 W driver loss, up to 26 V).
